homeIntro: Design system, i18n, SEO, forms and observability already wired. Replace this page with your own.
homeFeatureDesignSystem: Design system on Tailwind 4 and shadcn: atoms, layouts, molecules and sections documented in Storybook, with tokens and a light/dark theme that doesn't flash on load.
homeFeatureI18n: Translations with next-intl in Italian and English: every URL carries its locale prefix and the redirect follows the cookie and Accept-Language.
homeFeatureSeo: Metadata, canonicals, Open Graph, hreflang, sitemap and robots.
homeFeatureForms: Forms with react-hook-form and Zod: the same schema validates on the client and the server, with localized messages.
homeFeatureCache: Cache Components and a token-protected /api/revalidate endpoint to invalidate tags and paths from CMS webhooks.
homeFeatureSentry: Sentry on client, server and edge, with no personal data collected by default.
homeFeatureData: TanStack Query for remote data and nuqs for state in the URL.
homeFeatureUx: Toasts, a loading bar between pages, and localized 404 and error pages.
homeFeatureQuality: Strict TypeScript, ESLint with custom design system rules, and stories run as tests with Vitest and Playwright, a11y checks included.
homeFeatureEnv: Environment variables documented in .env.example, with secrets kept apart from what reaches the browser.
